hero.title: Complyr

methodSnippet.description: Add this snippet before the closing </head> tag on your homepage, then verify. It's the same snippet that runs your banner.

methodDns.description: Create this TXT record with your DNS provider, then verify. DNS changes can take a little while to propagate.
